notes: Employees from the 2025 Form 20-F Item 6.D table (full-time equivalents by geographic area at Dec 31, 2025; the rows give marketing and sales, research and development, production and supply, general and administration, then the total, which is the value recorded; the 2024 comparatives were reclassified to this four-category presentation). The 20-F uses spaces as thousands separators (12 556 = 12,556). Only the USA is a single country; the other three areas are Novartis groupings with no country list, so countries is null for them. Switzerland is not broken out. Sites are the 'Major facilities' table in Item 4.D (site size in square meters), which in the 2025 20-F lists 13 sites; the 12 kept here are those already recorded, and Ljubljana, Slovenia (144 717 m², newly listed) is left out to stay within the 12-site limit. Several site sizes and descriptions changed from the 2024 table (e.g. Kundl and Schaftenau 283 017 m², East Hanover 123 751 m²). Novartis says it runs a network of 31 manufacturing sites and closed, exited, consolidated or sold 6 sites in the three years to Dec 31, 2025. In the earlier research pass a web search found no published Novartis group country-by-country tax table (only a local Romania extract, not opened), so no tax rows (not re-checked in this refresh); no state-level data.
